name: Lotus Resources Limited
content: Lotus Resources Limited is an Australian-based uranium developer and explorer that owns an 85% interest in the Kayelekera Uranium Project in Malawi. The project is a proven uranium operation that successfully produced approximately 11 million pounds of uranium between 2009 and 2014 before being placed on care and maintenance. Lotus is focused on restarting production at Kayelekera to leverage the growing global demand for nuclear energy. Additionally, the company holds the Letlhakane Uranium Project in Botswana, one of the largest undeveloped uranium resources globally, further strengthening its position in the nuclear fuel supply chain.

Officers

Greg Bittar(Date: 2024 January)

Chief Executive Officer

Mr. Bittar has over 20 years' experience in public and private markets, mergers and acquisitions and capital markets in the resources, technology and energy sectors. He has extensive experience in the uranium sector, having been a director of several uranium companies.

Grant Davey(Date: 2019 June)

Executive Director

Mr. Davey is a mining engineer with over 30 years' experience in the mining industry. He has been involved in the development and operation of several mining projects in Africa and Australia.

Catherine Huynh(Date: 2023 July)

Chief Financial Officer

Ms. Huynh is a qualified accountant with over 15 years' experience in financial management and corporate advisory, specifically within the resources sector.

Directors

Michael Bowen(Date: 2021 February)

Non-Executive Chairman

Mr. Bowen is a partner at a major Australian law firm and has over 35 years' experience in corporate, commercial and securities law with a focus on the resources sector.

Grant Davey(Date: 2019 June)

Executive Director

Mr. Davey is a mining engineer with over 30 years' experience in the mining industry. He has been involved in the development and operation of several mining projects in Africa and Australia.

Mark J. Wheatley(Date: 2021 February)

Non-Executive Director

Mr. Wheatley has over 30 years' experience in the mining industry, including over 15 years in the uranium sector. He has held several executive and non-executive roles in uranium companies.

Dixie Marshall(Date: 2022 April)

Non-Executive Director

Ms. Marshall has over 30 years' experience in media, advertising, politics and communications. she has held senior executive roles in both the private and public sectors.
